items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had the toughest English teacher in the whole entire school -- Jefferson.

ctx.x: But for you, you were not actually performing music in school, that was something you did outside of school. So school really didn’t have an influence. As you said, Sam Brown, no real influence. The experience at Jefferson -­

You know what, in school I majored in English. I was going to be a writer. Dexter Gordon and myself were the only two guys, Hambone (unintelligible); we had the toughest English teacher in the whole entire school -- Jefferson. We were the only three dudes that got -- I got an A in English, man, believe it or not.
